text:
Mira: Heads up — I noticed the console's project key list is showing full service account display names and partially hashed org ids in telemetry view. Feels risky for customers that want minimal exposure.
Devon: hmm. Which view? the admin-only one or the usage dashboard? :thinking:
Mira: usage dashboard. It's gated by project read perms but some partner integrations pull screenshots for support tickets and we might be leaking org context.
Anna: Oof. We intentionally surfaced some claims for easier debugging (owner, project_slug). We masked the org_id but didn't think about display_name + slug pairing.
Samir: Is this more of a privacy/PII problem or an authorization-consistency one? Two different fixes.
Mira: Both. Customers ask for toggle to hide identifying labels in shared dashboards. Also our telemetry sampling keeps the names in traces which we ship to third-party analytics.
Devon: Proposal: hide display_name by default in non-admin dashboards and send only hashed identifiers to analytics. Add a console toggle for 'reveal debug labels' behind a rollout flag.
Anna: Agree on toggle. Implementation note: backend needs to stop enriching telemetry events with display_name unless reveal flag enabled per-org. That means a short API change to authz service.
Samir: Concern: a lot of internal dashboards / existing alerts depend on that field. We should plan a gradual rollout: default off, add migration shim that emits both hashed and unmasked for 30 days with sampling, then flip.
Devon: For telemetry, can we do deterministic hashing with per-org salt? That lets us correlate without exposing raw names.
Mira: Yes, but customers worry about re-identification across datasets. We should also document retention and sampling rates.
Anna: Minimal API example of masked response:
```
GET /v1/projects/:id/keys
200 OK
[
  {"id":"key_123","label":"redacted","owner_hash":"org_abc:deadbeef"}
]
```
Devon: Nice. For rollout: feature-flag + gradual rollout to 10% of orgs, telemetry opt-in for support teams. Add console banner for org admins when debug labels are hidden.
Samir: Need to update quota/alerting dashboards too — add a compatibility layer so existing alert rules can reference owner_hash instead of label.
Mira: I'll draft the rollout doc and a short migration checklist (API change, telemetry pipeline scrub, console toggle, support KB). Who can own the API change?
Anna: I can take the authz patch. Will add a feature flag in the response and a header `X-Labels-Revealed: false` for observability.
Devon: I'll do the console UX and add the admin banner + toggle in org settings.
Samir: I'll update telemetry pipeline + alerts and coordinate with analytics infra for the sampling plan.
audit-bot: Note: created incident draft #9873 - 'credential visibility policy' for tracking approvals and compliance review.
Mira: Thanks all — let's sync on Friday for sign-off. :+1:
